stories.name: Live map renders with vehicle markers
acceptance_criteria: Map loads in <2s with 50 vehicle markers
Vehicle markers color-coded by traffic light status
Map clusters markers at low zoom levels
env_limitations: MapLibre GL requires WebGL — component tests mock the map library. Visual verification of map rendering, marker colors, and clustering behavior requires a browser environment (not possible in jsdom/vitest).

stories.name: Real-time position updates
acceptance_criteria: Vehicle positions update in real-time via WebSocket (<5s latency)
Vehicle markers show direction of travel when moving
env_limitations: MapLibre GL requires WebGL — direction arrow rendering and rotation verified via MapLibre mock layer configuration, not visual rendering.
SSE stream test verifies headers and data format via mock; actual long-lived connection behavior requires a live server.

stories.name: Vehicle marker popup with stats
acceptance_criteria: Clicking vehicle marker opens popup with key stats and link to detail
env_limitations: MapLibre GL requires WebGL — popup rendering verified via MapLibre mock (Popup constructor, setHTML, setLngLat, addTo), not visual rendering.

stories.name: Map remembers zoom and center
acceptance_criteria: Map remembers zoom level and center between sessions
env_limitations: MapLibre GL requires WebGL — persistence behavior verified via mock (Map constructor options for restore, moveend handler + getCenter/getZoom for save). Actual localStorage interaction in browser not tested end-to-end.

stories.name: Add loading skeleton, error boundary, and empty state to DashboardMap using existing foundation components
env_limitations: MapLibre GL requires WebGL — loading skeleton visibility, error boundary catch, and empty state rendering verified via component mocks (FleetMap mocked). Visual rendering of skeleton animation and error styling requires browser environment.

stories.name: Trip start/end detection

Trip start threshold: speed >5km/h for >30s

Minimum trip distance: 200m to filter GPS drift
Trip distance calculated from actual GPS points along route

Simulator runs as a Docker Compose service alongside app and db

stories.name: Create and manage service schedules

Common service types pre-populated
Custom service types supported
Completed service resets the schedule countdown automatically

stories.name: Service alerts and notifications
acceptance_criteria: Alerts fire at configurable warning thresholds

stories.name: Log service with cost tracking

Receipt photo upload on service records

Driver sees only their assigned vehicle(s)
Driver login works on mobile browser

stories.name: Driver profiles and vehicle assignment
acceptance_criteria: Assignment history tracked with timestamps
License expiry alerts surface on dashboard
Pool mode: driver selects from available vehicles
Assigned mode: driver sees their primary vehicle on login

Tracking-active indicator visible at all times
End-shift toggle available to driver
Tracking schedule configurable by admin
Per-driver data export (JSON/CSV)
Per-driver data hard delete

stories.name: Custom inspection checklist templates

Inspection frequency alerts configurable

fix_tasks.title: Add authentication middleware to all data API routes
fix_tasks.description: POST /api/positions, GET /api/vehicles, and GET /api/positions/stream must require a valid session. Use existing requireAdmin() helper from src/lib/auth.ts. Position ingestion endpoint should accept either admin session or a configurable API key for the simulator.

fix_tasks.title: Whitelist columns in login route query
fix_tasks.description: Replace select("*") with explicit column selection: select("id, email, name, role, password_hash"). This limits exposure to only the columns needed for authentication.

fix_tasks.title: Add rate limiting to API endpoints
fix_tasks.description: Add basic rate limiting to position ingestion (100 requests/minute per IP), login (5 attempts/minute per IP). Can use a simple in-memory rate limiter for V1 single-process deployment.

fix_tasks.title: Optimize dashboard positions query
fix_tasks.description: Replace the fetch-all-positions approach with a DISTINCT ON query or maintain a latest_position column on the Vehicle model. Current approach will not scale beyond a few thousand position records.
